title: NAFEMS LE3 hemispherical shell with point loads (MITC4 shells)
source: NAFEMS, The Standard NAFEMS Benchmarks, TNSB Rev. 3, October 1990, test LE3 (target: radial displacement 0.185 m at A); the problem and target as reproduced in the Abaqus 2016 Benchmarks Guide, section 4.2.3 'LE3: Hemispherical shell with point loads', and in the ESRD StressCheck Benchmarks Guide 'The Standard NAFEMS Benchmarks: Linear Elastic Tests' (2018), p. 12

quantities.reason: the target is published to three figures; the displacement under a point load on a shear-deformable shell keeps growing slowly as the mesh is refined (32 × 32 is 0.44% low, 64 × 64 0.16%; see README)
